card.name: Space before dose numbers in nutrition dosing
card.fires_on: The space or decimal point right before a dose or amount figure, mostly in parenteral nutrition and daily-dose tables. It sits before a number such as 25 g, 2000 mg, 0.8 to 1.0 or 4 calories.

modes.label: Space before amount
modes.description: A blank space just ahead of a number giving a daily dose, maximum or calorie amount.

modes.label: Decimal point in ranges
modes.description: The point after a leading 0 in dose range tables for amino acids or fluids.

card.writes: It pushes down bone-related words, and the promoted tokens are unrelated, so it mainly acts as a suppressor of bone terms before numbers.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a dose amount in nutrition dosing tables, where a number is about to appear.
